name: koala-removal-product-runtime
title: Remove koala from product runtime code and rename KOALA_ env vars to LATTICE_ (ship-clean story 2)
description: The public proofbound repo still ships the retired internal codename koala in product runtime code; story 2 strips it from packages/*/src and renames every KOALA_ environment variable to LATTICE_, with no backward-compat, before the open-source launch.
